df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# shade_pct robustness
m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct + C(farm)', data=df).fit()
print(m.params['shade_pct'], m.pvalues['shade_pct'])
# per-farm
for f in df['farm'].unique():
    sub = df[df['farm']==f]
    mm = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct', data=sub).fit()
    print(f, round(mm.params['shade_pct'],3), round(mm.pvalues['shade_pct'],3), len(sub))
# check nonlinearity
df['shade2']=df['shade_pct']**2
m2 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct + shade2 + C(farm)', data=df).fit()
print('quad', m2.params['shade_pct'], m2.pvalues['shade_pct'], m2.pvalues['shade2'])
# missing values
print(df.isna().sum())
